leftEvidence.title: The place is named for testing and quarreling

points.label: Setting
points.left: Israel camps at Rephidim and disputes with Moses over water.
points.right: Hebrews quotes the wilderness provocation and repeatedly says “today.”

points.label: Movement
points.left: How do the people, Moses, and the LORD speak as the lack of water becomes a test.
points.right: How does the quotation move between remembered testing and the hearer’s present day.

payload.posture: Hold the two Scripture sources together without assigning one function to every wilderness Scene.

rightEvidence.title: The wilderness provocation is quoted with the word “today”

payload.tension: The shared wilderness setting carries story link while the actors, actions, and outcomes remain distinct.
payload.title: Testing named / testing quoted
